title: coelogyne schaiblei
intro: Coelogyne schaiblei, commonly known as the golden orchid, is a type of orchid species known for its unique appearance and medicinal properties. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne schaiblei include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
